Subject: VPC deployment — fees & support (pricing clarification)

Camila,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. A couple of follow-ups from our procurement and finance teams as we move toward an internal approval:

- We need clarity on the platform fee: is it invoiced as an annual fixed platform fee separate from usage, or can it be amortized across committed infra spend?
- Support tiers: what are the differences between Enterprise and Enterprise+ (SLA, phone support, named CSM)? Can we get a sample SOW and a migration credit if we sign for 3 years?
- Pricing concession: Nordic HealthTech is prepared to commit to a 36-month reserved capacity plan (initially 6 production GPUs + burst) — what discount band do you typically offer for a multi-year, multi-region VPC deployment?

We'd also like to see a one-page cost summary and an editable SOW so our legal can start a side-by-side review.

Oliver

Nordic HealthTech

Oliver — thanks for the clear list. I'm attaching a formal proposal and a draft SOW for your team (see attachments). Quick answers up front and a proposed path forward: 

- Platform fee: invoiced annually as a platform/console/license fee. For multi-year commitments we can amortize the economics by offering either a reduced platform fee in year 1 or a one-time migration credit; both are how we preserve unit economics.
- Support tiers: Enterprise includes 24x5 support, access to dedicated onboarding resources, and quarterly business reviews. Enterprise+ adds 24x7 SLA response, named CSM, and advanced escalation playbooks. I'll call out the differences in the proposal appendix.
- Discount band: for a 36-month reserved commitment we typically consider a combination of a year-1 platform fee concession + recurring infra discount. Baseline internal range is 10–20% depending on term and committed spend.

Attached: Redwood_VPC_Pricing_Proposal_v3.pdf (proposal with pricing bands) and SOW_NordicHealth_v1.2.docx (editable).

If you can confirm the target monthly committed spend and which support tier you want packaged, I will pull final numbers and get internal approvals. Happy to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
